<!--
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
====================
GitHub Issues are used to divide the project into small, clear tasks.

A good issue must define:
INPUT → WORK → OUTPUT → CONSUMER → TEST

That prevents vague tasks such as:
"work on AI"
or
"finish backend".
-->
